newsitem.title: GERMANY: IG Metall's Zwickel sees no chance of compromise.
newsitem.headline: IG Metall's Zwickel sees no chance of compromise.

text.p: Klaus Zwickel, head of Germany's largest trade union, IG Metall, said on Wednesday there was no chance of a compromise at the moment in the pay dispute between the engineering union and employers.
"Clearly, we have to strike to make (the employers federation) Gesamtmetall see sense," said Zwickel.
Zwickel said employers had shown themselves as unfit representatives in the last three rounds of talks and that the employers had caused the row in the first place.
The two sides are engaged in a bitter row over planned cuts to sick pay to 80 percent from 100 percent, which has already triggered nationwide protests by IG Metall members.
